name: Abraham Lincoln
note: assetkit-models-sf/lincoln-city-hall: OSM node 1901905716, City Hall's Polk Street side, facing east; bronze on a pale granite die (owner's photo, 2026-10-18).

name: Dewey Monument (capital and Victory)
note: assetkit-models-sf/dewey-monument-pbr (the PBR variant: darker verdigris, closer to the real near-black): the capital, drum, globe and Victory on the shaft's plain top, sunk 0.15 m into it so no seam shows (owner, 2026-10-18). The model's neck is 1.5 m across, the shaft's top (union-square.ts r 0.75).

name: Admission Day Monument miner
note: assetkit-models-sf/admission-day-miner: OSM node 386573810 (Market, Post and Montgomery). The real monument is Tilden's granite column with the winged figure on top and this bronze miner with his flag at its foot, so the procedural column stays and the miner stands 3.6 m in front of it, facing down Market (bearing 50, from the site).

name: The Cider Press
note: assetkit-models-sf/cider-press: OSM way 1454996308 (tourism=artwork), Music Concourse, Golden Gate Park. Bearing 270 is a guess toward the Concourse; 2.5 m (about.md).

name: Andrea fountain mermaids
note: assetkit-models-sf/asawa-mermaid-fountain: the mermaids on the central plinth of the procedural basin (art.ts asawaMermaidFountain, which was built for them), moved to OSM way 939539789, the pool on Ghirardelli Square's terrace.

name: Ashurbanipal
note: assetkit-models-sf/ashurbanipal: OSM node 6465902729, Fulton Street by the Main Library, facing south across Fulton to the library (Parhad's Wikipedia entry); 2.5 m on a 2.0 m pedestal.

name: Beethoven bust
note: assetkit-models-sf/beethoven-bust: OSM way 1210652265, SE side of the Music Concourse, Golden Gate Park, facing northwest into it (a guess).

name: Benjamin Franklin
note: assetkit-models-sf/franklin-washington-square: OSM node 434700934, Washington Square, facing south toward the church (a guess); 2.4 m on a ~3.4 m pedestal.

name: Bufano St. Francis
